messages:
julia-cs: Customer ACME reporting spikes of 502/504s on hosted inference since ~09:15 UTC. They see ~30% errors during bursts and timeouts. Escalating — INC-43210.
support: Repro summary: spike -> gateway 502 after ~12s queued, backend returns timeout/504. Traces show long scale-up latency and pods not Ready. See logs: <internal_logs_link>.
opsbot: :rotating_light: Alert: autoscaler-scaleup-delay breached for tenant=acme-prod (scaledobject=acme-embed) at 2026-03-17T09:16:03Z
maya-oncall: Looking. Can someone grab KEDA/ HPA events and pod init logs? Suspect readiness probe too aggressive + cold model init.
alex: Commands to gather: `kubectl get scaledobject acme-embed -n hosted -o yaml`
`kubectl describe hpa acme-embed -n hosted`
`kubectl logs -l app=acme-embed -n hosted --tail=200`
kevin: Note: yesterday's runtime deploy increased model init mem ~20%. Also infra flagged registry pull throttles earlier (401/429) during token rotation — could slow image pulls.
ryan-ml: Model variant is ~8GB. First-token init (model load + KV warm) measured 6–8s on our baseline GPU. Warmup probe currently 5s — too short.
alex: From events: KEDA emitted scale event but HPA didn't drive immediate ready pods; new pods stuck in InitContainers for ~18s due to image pulls and init unpack. Logs show intermittent 401/403 on registry -> retries + backoff.
maya-oncall: Proposed immediate actions: 1) Increase readinessProbe timeout/initialDelay for acme-embed 2) Add prewarm replicas annotation on scaledobject for this tenant 3) Temporary: enable fallback to quantized smaller model for acme until warmup fixed 4) Engage infra to check registry token rotation/billing  (tagging kevin + ops)
julia-cs: Customer asks for ETA. Can we offer <2h mitigation and communicate changes? They also saw a 403 when uploading artifacts earlier — possibly related to token rotation.
kevin: I will push a canary to add `scaledobject.keda.sh/prewarm: "2"` and bump readinessProbe timeout to 20s for acme-embed. Rolling a small patch now.
deploy-bot: Deploy triggered by kevin: canary update acme-embed-prewarm at 2026-03-17T09:34:12Z.
opsbot: Monitor update: error-rate for tenant acme-prod down from 30% -> 4% in last 12m, p95 latency improved ~200ms. :thumbsup:
maya-oncall: Follow-ups (post-mitigation): schedule infra token rotation patch, add alert for "scaleup-pending>10s", update playbook to suggest prewarm for models >5GB, and liaise with billing for the 403s. I'll own.
julia-cs: Sending customer note: mitigation applied (prewarm + probe bump), monitoring shows improvement, will follow up with ETA for permanent fix and root cause.
kevin: I'll open PR to make prewarm annotation part of tenant profile and queue a dedicated ticket for image pull auth hardening.
